name: Mail Concierge
description: Mail Concierge lets administrators invite people by e-mail, lets users recover their password by e-mail and, if the administrator allows it, sign in with their e-mail address, without any change to Jellyfin itself.
overview: E-mail invitations, e-mail password recovery and sign-in by e-mail address for Jellyfin

versions.changelog: Sign in with your confirmed e-mail address (off by default), and a series of security and reliability fixes; this release needs Jellyfin 12.4. Jellyfin 12.1 to 12.3 stay on 12.0.0.0.
First public release: e-mail invitations, e-mail password recovery, e-mail address in the profile, optional Seerr synchronisation, English, French, Spanish and German.
